solver.algorithm: Hildreth cyclic nonnegative dual coordinate ascent on row-normalized Gram matrix
solver.objective: minimize one half squared unrounded update norm subject to every supplied inequality
solver.scope: Numerical minimum-norm analysis of the supplied finite local linear inequalities in fixed update coordinates. No BF16, nonlinear behavior, hidden evaluation or promotion authority. Numerical certificates use floating-point residuals and conservative roundoff padding, not formally verified interval arithmetic.
